steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><i>All is in alignment. This will be her end.</color><i>
The other senators give silent nods of approval. The Unity Gala is about to begin. Everything will proceed as planned.
Marcus puts away the chessboard. The peace dove is his prisoner now. He could end her here, or...
If they want to take this a step further, turning the knife back on DisCity...
The Campbells aren't the only ones who know how to play this game...

10:00 AM
Fraser Hotel
2 hours until the Unity Gala begins
As the gala's opening draws near, the hotel housing the farland delegation grows quiet. Rael, who detests float parades, has lingered inside until the last possible moment.
Just as he turns to summon his companions, he brushes shoulders with an attendant dressed in Fraser attire.
With a suspicious look and hurried steps, the Aurum Secretum attendant rushes off, oblivious to the note that has fallen from his uniform.

Rael's instincts, ever vigilant, flare. In the attendant's blind haste, he sees an opening. With a fluid motion, he stoops, snatches the paper, and conceals it in his pocket. Only once he reaches a secluded corridor does he dare to unfold it. A line of deliberately distorted, encrypted text stares back, yet its meaning is unmistakable:
Mr. Jabara, your trade manifest has been delivered. Please come to Room X-2 alone for the handover. And be careful. Do not let Fraser or the Alliance discover this.

Room X-2 is a spartan staff quarters, dominated by a blazing fireplace. A stocky figure crouches before it, muttering as he deliberates over which pages from a stack of documents to feed into the hungry flames.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Sigh, I've decided to burn them... Feels like such a waste, though. Could've used these to squeeze a better deal later...

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: But that person was right. They'll search everyone at the gate. Can't leave them here in the hotel, either...

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: I'm no traitor. Business is business. A man's gotta be flexible...
As he feeds the documents to the flames, the door crashes open behind him.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: ******* you! What in the hell are you doing?!
Rael storms into the room, snatches the documents from Jabara's hands, and holds them to the firelight.

Hypercube smuggling routes with Nirvana. Stock manipulations rigging food prices. Unjust profit distributions... Page after page, the details coalesce into a single truth: only the middleman wins, raking in obscene wealth without a shred of risk.
His breath hitches, then turns to ragged panting. With a surge of fury, he hurls the papers aside, seizes Jabara by the collar, and hauls him violently to his feet.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: You slimy bastard! You ******* played us!

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: We had a deal! Farland resources stay with our people! So what's this "cooperation" with Nirvana? When the **** did you start dealing with DisCity again?!

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: Wait, wait! Let me explain! These are old, I swear! Nothing since that day! My dealings with DisCity ended then, I promise!
Jabara shoves the remaining documents behind his back, his movements frantic.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: I don't believe you. I ******* don't. Hand them over.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: H-hey, don't!! Tho-Those are my livelihood!
After a brief struggle, Rael wrenches the remaining documents free. One glance is enough, and blind fury takes over. His hand snaps to his waist.

steps.speaker: Rael
steps.content: I'm gonna put a bullet in your head!!!
THUD!!
A dull thud sounds behind Rael's head. His body sways, then he crumples to the floor. Only Jabara remains, slumped against the fireplace with a face frozen in terror.
From the shadows, an Aurum Secretum Warrior steps forward and collects the scattered documents.

steps.speaker: Jabara
steps.content: You're—?!
Saina's knuckles whiten, the paper crumpling in her grasp as each documented corruption fuels her fury. The details are explicit, damning, and infuriating.
Yet with a final, shuddering breath, she squeezes her eyes shut, wrestles her rage into submission, and forces herself to speak.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: What else is there? This isn't everything, is it?

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Hand it all over. Now.
